concept.title: Repository mirroring
concept.shortdesc: With repository mirroring in Red Hat Quay, you can copy images from an external registry into your cluster. You sync by repository or organization name and tag, set intervals, and filter architectures.

conbody.p: From a Red Hat Quay registry with mirroring enabled, you can:

ul.li: Choose a repository or organization from an external registry to mirror
Add credentials to access the external registry
Identify specific container image repository or organization names and tags to sync
Set intervals at which a repository or organization is synced
Check the current state of synchronization
Filter the architectures that are mirrored

conbody.p: Repository mirroring suits distinct registries that must share selected upstream content. You can configure mirroring in the Red Hat Quay configuration file or by using the Red Hat Quay API when you are ready to implement it.
